runtime: Python 3.9 or later; standard library only; no network access at runtime

source_reference.verification: Every public evaluate_case and run_campaign call reads and SHA256-checks both files. A campaign checks once before evaluation. The actual bytes, rather than a caller-supplied hash or commit string, determine acceptance. The reference commit/tree identify the source provenance; no assertion is made that the caller's entire checkout is at that commit or tree. No Lean execution, dependency hash check or whole-tree attestation is performed.

mathematical_contract.population: Nonempty finite list of atoms, with equal-length probability vector p and signed rational vector R.
premises: r > 0 and epsilon > 0, with no upper bound on r.
M >= sum_i p_i R_i^40. M must be nonnegative; a nonnegative but insufficient M returns FALSE_PREMISE.
mathematical_contract.event: For each atom i, epsilon < r * R_i^5, strictly and with signed R.
mathematical_contract.arithmetic: All mathematical decisions use fractions.Fraction and exact integers. No float is accepted as a mathematical input. CLI elapsed_seconds is timing metadata only.
mathematical_contract.finite_integrability: Every finite rational vector has finite fortieth moment; all subsets are measurable in its finite discrete probability model.
unsupported: General real-valued or infinite probability measures and arbitrary measurable spaces
Gaussian models, derivative suprema and existence of a model-specific fortieth-moment bound
Weighted-law r4/r3 targets, uniform families, Palm normalizers, Kac-Rice or parent persistence theorems
Other declarations, generic unpublished interpreter APIs, Lean kernel verification and automatic federation target inventory reduction
mathematical_contract.evidence_limit: Finite observations may falsify an implementation or expose a finite witness. Passing samples never establish a universal theorem, scientific CLOSED status, full CBZ completion or full-federation admission. The existing theorem, hypotheses, bound, original tests, manifests and pre-existing workflows are unchanged.

case_schema.target: Exact target string above; other strings are UNSUPPORTED.
case_schema.p_and_R: Nonempty list or tuple in Python; JSON arrays at the CLI. Lengths must agree.
case_schema.number: Python int excluding bool; fractions.Fraction; or an ASCII string matching -?[0-9]+(?:/[1-9][0-9]*)?. Denominators are positive. Strings are normalized to reduced rational output. Floats, bools, decimal/exponent strings, whitespace, nonfinite names and malformed or zero-denominator rationals are rejected.
case_schema.unknown_fields: INVALID, including fields for unsupported weighted/family extensions.

python_api.import: Load adapter.py using importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, or import cbz.finite_moment_tail_20261030.adapter from the repository root as a namespace package.
python_api.evaluate_case: evaluate_case(case, *, source_root=None) -> dict. Always verifies required source bytes. Default source root is the repository root inferred from adapter.py. source_root may be a str or pathlib.Path. Returns classified JSON-serializable data; does not mutate input.
python_api.verify_sources: verify_sources(source_root=None) -> binding dict. VERIFIED means exactly the two required file hashes match. Read/missing-file errors become MISMATCH with error class. Reference labels do not attest the entire checkout.
python_api.generate_cases: generate_cases(*, seed=20261030, count=10019) -> iterator of exactly count distinct valid canonical case dicts. seed must have exact int type, count must have exact int type and be > 0; invalid arguments raise ValueError when iterated. A deterministic pathological prefix is followed by random.Random(seed) integer/rational generation, with canonical identity deduplication.
python_api.run_campaign: run_campaign(*, cases=None, seed=20261030, count=10019, source_root=None) -> dict. With cases=None generate count observations; otherwise cases must be list or tuple and count/seed do not affect that population. A bad seed/count in generated mode, invalid supplied population, source mismatch or empty population returns REFUSED. All cases in a supplied population are processed. One refusal prevents BOUNDED_OBSERVATIONS. No hidden external interpreter or mutable registry is imported.
python_api.argument_boundary: Case/domain failures return classified results. Incorrect Python call signatures or non-pathlike source_root values are programmer errors, not classified mathematical cases. Resource exhaustion and underlying interpreter integer-string limits are not universal rational computation claims.

statuses.OBSERVED_BOUND: Valid finite case whose exact event mass is <= exact bound.
statuses.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Admitted finite case whose computed event mass exceeds the bound; warrants investigation and is never proof acceptance.
statuses.FALSE_PREMISE: Well-shaped nonnegative M is below actual moment40; no bound result and no mathematical counterexample credit.
statuses.INVALID: Malformed schema, numeric type, probability vector, shape, positivity or negative M.
statuses.UNSUPPORTED: Target string is outside the single supported declaration.
statuses.SOURCE_MISMATCH: Required source bytes missing, unreadable or different; no mathematical evaluation.

case_result_schema.all_public_results: status and source_binding; refused results carry reason.
case_result_schema.normalized_results: For admitted numeric shape: case (canonical rational strings), case_id (SHA256 canonical JSON), target and moment40. FALSE_PREMISE stops here with reason.
case_result_schema.observations: event (boolean array), event_mass, bound and slack=bound-event_mass (reduced rational strings). COUNTEREXAMPLE includes the same exact witness fields.
case_result_schema.case_id_encoding: SHA256 of ASCII json.dumps(normalized_case, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True). Atom ordering and zero-mass atoms are preserved; this identifies a canonical input observation, not a probability-law equivalence class.
case_result_schema.source_binding: status VERIFIED/MISMATCH, reference_commit, reference_tree, scope TWO_EXACT_SOURCE_FILES_ONLY, files mapping each relative path to expected_sha256, actual_sha256, bytes, matches and optional read error class.

campaign_report_schema.status: BOUNDED_OBSERVATIONS only for a nonempty all-admitted population with no counterexample; COUNTEREXAMPLE if at least one admitted violation exists (even if other inputs are refused); otherwise REFUSED.

counts.attempted: Each processed case, including rejected cases.
counts.valid: Cases admitted to the inequality check, including any counterexamples and repeats.
counts.source_mismatch: SOURCE_MISMATCH cases. Preflight source failure prevents iteration, so attempted and all counts remain zero; binding and reason retain the actual failure.
counts.counterexamples: Subset of valid with event_mass > bound.
counts.distinct_valid: Number of unique canonical valid case_id values; repeats do not earn distinct credit.

campaign_report_schema.count_identity: attempted = valid + invalid + false_premise + unsupported + source_mismatch; counterexamples <= valid; distinct_valid <= valid.
campaign_report_schema.source_binding: The exact source preflight record used for this campaign.
campaign_report_schema.seed: Generated integer seed; null for supplied populations or invalid generated seed.
campaign_report_schema.cases_digest: SHA256 of each valid case_id plus an ASCII newline, in observation order. Refused cases are excluded from this digest and retained as witnesses. An empty valid sequence uses SHA256 of empty bytes.
campaign_report_schema.witnesses: Array of {index: zero-based attempted index, result: exact classified result}, for every refused case and every admitted counterexample. Successful observations are reproducible from generator seed/count or supplied original cases and the digest.
campaign_report_schema.other_fields: scope FINITE_RATIONAL_OBSERVATIONS_ONLY; scientific_effect NONE; full_federation_admitted false; reason on preflight or population refusal.
campaign_report_schema.determinism: The Python report has no clock fields and is deterministic for identical source bytes, inputs and interpreter generator behavior. CLI execution adds nondeterministic elapsed_seconds; exclude execution when comparing mathematical replay.

cli.strict_json: Duplicate object keys and NaN/Infinity/-Infinity are rejected at every JSON object level. Float JSON numbers are rejected as mathematical values. JSON null in --stdin-cases is INVALID, never an implicit request for a generated population. Unknown case fields cannot be silently ignored.
cli.stdout: One JSON result including execution: argv, python version, actual sys.flags.optimize, elapsed_seconds. stdin JSON errors are JSON INVALID results. Command syntax errors use argparse usage text on stderr.

exit_codes.2: Refused, invalid, unsupported, false premise, source mismatch or command syntax error

test_design.independent_oracle: Tests decide strict signed event membership with integer numerator/denominator cross-products, independently accumulate Fraction moments/mass, and evaluate the bound as M*(r/epsilon)^8. The 10019-case test compares every generated observation with that oracle.
test_design.pathologies: Exact equality and rational neighbors; signed and all-negative values; zero-mass huge atoms; zero moment; r>1; tiny/large rationals; moment slack; nonnormalized/negative probabilities; shape mismatch; unsupported targets; empty campaigns; numeric aliases; source tampering and missing source.
test_design.real_source_mutants: Temporary source files omit epsilon denominator, use r^16, replace bound moment by moment20, replace admission moment40 by moment20, or weaken the strict event to <=. Each is executed by child unittest processes both normally and with -O, requiring intended assertion failure, exit 1 and zero errors. The moment20 admission regression is tested using insufficient M=2^20 at R=2; its failure is admission behavior evidence, never an admitted mathematical counterexample. A valid M=2^40 control is separate.
test_design.optional_raw_evidence: Set MOMENT_TAIL_EVIDENCE_DIR to a private directory when running tests to preserve each actual mutant source, source cut, source SHA256, argv, parent/child optimization, return code and stdout/stderr. No evidence files are written by default. MOMENT_TAIL_ADAPTER_FILE is a test-only alternate actual source path, not a production evaluator switch.
test_design.interpretation: Mutant assertion failures demonstrate bounded executable discrimination. Import errors, invalid mathematical inputs, source mismatches and unsupported statuses receive no mathematical counterexample credit.

integration_boundary: This is a complete standalone component offered for future compatible generic-harness integration and native governance registration. It registers no global target, changes no manifest or pre-existing workflow, and creates no interpreter stub. The native CI workflow below performs only this bounded component self-test; it establishes no required-status binding or global gate. Any later admission must bind the actual integrated source and preserve the unsupported inventory and finite-specialization label.

native_ci.triggers: Every pull_request, every push to main, and workflow_dispatch; no path filtering or schedule.
native_ci.runtime: ubuntu-latest; actions/setup-python pins Python 3.11.16; standard library only; no dependency installation or network calls by verification commands.
native_ci.permissions: contents: read; checkout persist-credentials: false; no secrets are requested; job timeout 20 minutes.
native_ci.execution: The inline stdlib Python orchestrator invokes every command in order with subprocess.run(shell=False), sys.executable, -B and explicit -O for optimized children. Each command has a 150 second timeout. A command failure, launch exception or timeout is retained and later commands still execute. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 applies to all children; MOMENT_TAIL_EVIDENCE_DIR is RUNNER_TEMP/finite-moment-tail/mutants.
native_ci.evidence_directory: RUNNER_TEMP/finite-moment-tail must not exist initially; an existing directory is preserved and the invocation fails. Each invocation uses its fresh runner temporary directory.

receipt_schema.receipt.json: Actual checkout git HEAD SHA, committed tree and worktree status with metadata argv/rc/stdout/stderr; GitHub SHA/run/attempt/event labels separately; actual orchestrator executable/version/platform/optimization, environment and UTC timing; six command entries; errors, before/after scoped source hashes, changed paths and PASS/FAIL component execution status. The actual checkout may be a PR merge commit; source_reference commit/tree above remain provenance only. A dirty local checkout is represented by its git status and actual scoped hashes, not rebound to the committed tree.
receipt_schema.command_receipts: 01-adapter-normal through 06-campaign-optimized each retain .json, .stdout and .stderr. JSON records actual complete argv, shell=false, rc (null on launch error/timeout), elapsed/UTC timings, requested optimization, executable and raw output SHA256. Campaign JSON stdout supplies actual child runtime/optimization plus counts/status; its execution/counts/status are also copied into the command receipt. Mutant/CLI sources, receipts and raw outputs are retained separately beneath mutants by unchanged tests.

native_ci.failure_policy: The final orchestrator step exits nonzero if any command has a nonzero or missing exit, campaign execution metadata cannot be read or optimization mismatches, scoped source bytes change or are unreadable, checkout metadata fails, fewer than six commands complete, or an internal orchestrator error occurs. Raw failures remain evidence; the step is never continue-on-error.
native_ci.artifact: Pinned upload-artifact runs with always(), uploads the entire evidence directory as finite-moment-tail-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}, and uses if-no-files-found: error. Upload failure fails the job. Neither a missing artifact nor a failed command qualifies as a green run.
native_ci.limitations: This bounded empirical component workflow does not attest the entire federation, run Lean, establish universal mathematics or scientific CLOSED status, reduce unsupported target inventory, create a required-status setting, or declare G0-G11/full CBZ admission. Local replay proves only the recorded local runtime; hosted Python 3.11.16 execution requires a fresh hosted run/attempt and artifact.
